subject: Segmented region blackout — opt-in reroute steps & audit attachments
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: platform_ops@fennel.ai, alice.kim@fennel.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 14 Nov 2028 08:12:00 -0500
Subject: Segmented region blackout — opt-in reroute steps & audit attachments

Good morning Alice / Fennel platform team,

Short update and immediate ask: we are observing a segmented network blackout impacting multiple cloud egress points in EU-West and APAC-Southeast that is affecting a subset of tenant traffic. Some requests are being dropped upstream by peering fabric in the provider backbone, which is causing TTL-level failures and a spike in 5xx from our EU/APAC front doors.

What Redwood is doing now
- We have activated our regional fallback policy: traffic for affected tenants can be auto-redirected to partner-hosted fallbacks in the US-east region or to our alternate EU node (eu-central) depending on latency tolerance.
- Ops has opened INC-1342 and is running a live mitigation runbook (link below).
- We will capture per-tenant request traces and provide an export for audit/SOC evidence.

What we need from you (action requested)
Please reply to this thread with one of the options below so we can apply the change for your account (Fennel AI / tenant fennel-prod):
1) Opt-in to automatic reroute to US-east fallback (best-effort; will increase round-trip latency ~80–120ms but restores availability).
2) Opt-in to reroute to eu-central alternate node (lower latency but may be capacity constrained; will be rate-limited during peak).
3) No reroute — we will continue attempts and keep you updated (risk: intermittent 5xx/connection drops).

If you choose 1 or 2, please confirm: a) which option, b) whether we can update your ingresses (no code change required), and c) your preferred maintenance window (immediate / 2 hours / overnight).

Attached: reroute-checklist.pdf (step-by-step opt-in), reroute-config-sample.yaml (what we will push), incident-summary-20281114.txt (current timeline + logs excerpt).

SLA / credits: I understand the ask on credits given this outage — please mark in your reply and I will escalate to Finance + Legal for a formal review; we will include a preliminary service-impact summary in the postmortem.

Timeline: we expect a mitigation decision within 60–90 minutes pending your reply.

Thanks — we want to get you back to steady state with minimal disruption.

—
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0194

On Tue, 14 Nov 2028 at 08:40 AM, platform_ops@fennel.ai wrote:
> Ben — thanks for the heads up. We have two production clusters hitting intermittent 5xx starting ~07:50 UTC. Can you confirm whether IP allowlist changes are required for the US-east fallback? Also need a short blurb for our on-call rotation explaining expected behavior if we opt-in.
>
> — Alice
From: Alice Kim <platform_ops@fennel.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Nov 2028 08:40:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Segmented region blackout — opt-in reroute steps & audit attachments

Ben —

Thanks for the quick note. A couple quick clarifications from our side:
- Do we need to change our firewall egress allowlist to let the US-east fallback through? If so, can you provide the CIDR blocks?
- If we accept the reroute, what is the expected authentication behavior (will API keys / IP allowlist / TLS certs be preserved)?
- We will likely ask for an SLA credit given production impact — plz include next steps for that review.

We are leaning toward the eu-central alternate node if you can guarantee session affinity for at least 2 minutes for our streaming sessions. Our customers are sensitive to session drops.

Also copying contracts@fennel.ai for the SLA question.

Alice Kim
Platform Ops Manager, Fennel AI
platform_ops@fennel.ai

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: platform_ops@fennel.ai, alice.kim@fennel.ai
Date: Tue, 14 Nov 2028 11:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Segmented region blackout — opt-in reroute steps & audit attachments

Team —

Summary of customer preference: Fennel is leaning toward eu-central alternate node, with session-affinity concerns for streaming. They also want SLA credit review routed to Contracts. Action items below.

Immediate technical plan (Marcus + Laura)- 1) Prepare reroute push for fennel-prod to eu-central. Use the sample in reroute-config-sample.yaml.
- 2) Ensure sticky session window of 2 minutes for long-poll/streaming connections (append X-Session-Affinity TTL=120s in downstream proxy).
- 3) Add ephemeral exception to ingress allowlist if needed; customer said they will only open ports if we provide CIDRs (see below).

Firewall/CIDR blocks (quick list)
- eu-central fallback: 34.200.12.0/22, 34.200.16.0/22
- us-east fallback: 3.120.48.0/20

Validation checks (Laura)
- Smoke tests against eu-central endpoint (5 warm requests across streaming and short-poll).
- Confirm token exchange and API key acceptance — redisplay keys consumed without rotation.
- Record per-request latency histogram for 15 minutes after the switch.

Customer communication (Ben / Vanessa)
- Draft the status note to Fennel with: (a) confirmation of option selected, (b) expected latency delta, (c) session-affinity guarantee, (d) how to opt-back to normal once the provider clears.

Legal / SLA (Vanessa)
- Escalate potential credit request to Finance + Legal and hold a preliminary credit tally.

I will coordinate the push as soon as Laura confirms smoke tests pass. Keep this thread for external transparency.

—
Ben

From: platform_ops@fennel.ai <platform_ops@fennel.ai>

Date: Tue, 14 Nov 2028 16:29:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Segmented region blackout — opt-in reroute steps & audit attachments

Ben / team —

We confirm: fennel-prod opts into option 2 (reroute to eu-central). Please proceed immediately and keep us posted on the smoke-test results. We will not change our firewall unless you ask us to; do the reroute without any customer-side network changes if possible.

For the SLA credit — we want the formal credit request steps sent to contracts@fennel.ai and a preliminary impact window estimate for internal review.

On-call behavior note for our rotation: when reroute is active, streaming sessions may observe a ~50–90ms increase. If session drops exceed 0.5% for 5 minutes, we should roll back to the previous route and open a support ticket.

Thanks,

Alice Kim
Platform Ops Manager, Fennel AI
platform_ops@fennel.ai
